notes.title: Version 1.7.0
notes.notes:
Hello pirates!
In this update, we have fixed various bugs that you reported to us:


 Updated game events
 Fixed a bug that made the achievement "The One" more difficult to obtain than the required condition
 Fixed a bug with the accounting of the game time in the sea mode 
 Several fixes were made to improve the first-person gameplay experience: more accurate display of the map in your hands, refinement of the camera, and more accurate binding of the rotation angle when tracking the ship
 Revised the shadow system to optimize and improve rendering
 Improved display of legends in the character's journal
 Several minor corrections to the texts of the quest tasks
 Minor interface fixes

notes.title: The hotfix has set sail!
notes.notes:
Hey, pirates!

We are glad to inform you that the hotfix is live. Ship sails are visible again and the quest “All aboard” no longer makes the game crash.

Thank you for your patience and understanding. Our team wishes you good luck in your search for Sun Wukong's Golden Staff ;)

notes.title: Announcing the Pirate City DLC + new update
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11019625/d1b5d432e26ae2062013649ec7fe08d9aefb22ae.jpg
Ahoy, fellow pirates! We’ve got some great news for everyone who already roves the seas of Tempest or was looking for a perfect opportunity to join our crew. A long-awaited expansion, the Pirate City DLC, is going to be released soon on Steam along with the basic game getting an update. So, what shiny new treasures should you expect? 

New mechanics are coming

First of all, Pirate City adds one of the highly requested features: an ability to build and develop your own settlement. By being a thoughtful governor you will be able to turn a simple village into a thriving city... and get quite a few new quests!  https://youtu.be/eUHPIJHkvGE Other than that, you will be able to buy a share in any shop no matter where it is located. This will certainly improve your financial situation so you can invest even more funds in your own city and make your neighbors envious of your success!

Players can also expect a brand new sinister looking ship that goes under the name of Grim Reaper and can be decorated with 4 extra figureheads: wolf, tiger, bear and lion. Here’s a teaser of the brig in action, which is available for boarding and capturing (but only the bravest may dare —  the crew of this ship is a bit... unusual):

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11019625/d096e3dbf51b9267d47866d9501b73dd5aaa228b.jpg

We are also introducing a land based battle arena that will be located near your city, so you can test your captain’s melee fighting skills against skeletons and pirate zombies. Yes, we said PIRATE ZOMBIES =) 

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11019625/1e0d756b02c29f7b032880672714e618f9a6bd2e.jpg

Enter the arena, pick a weapon of choice and get ready to rumble! The more waves of enemies you can survive, the bigger the reward! New achievements included ;)

The Base game (Tempest) gets an update

Along with the release of the Pirate City DLC, the base game will also feature a general overhaul including an updated tutorial, improved water physics and some updates to visuals. Plus, quite a few bugs were sent to walk the plank!

More details to follow regarding our next DLC and the patch in future updates, so stay in touch, captains! https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11019625/d6a6dfd4275d45519cc6f099fbbb48daa51024b0.png

Hey, pirates! We’ve got some great news for Linux users out there, as we have just updated the beta version of Tempest build for this OS. Check it out right now and share your opinion in the comments section! All you need to do is to go to the game properties in your library, select testing_linux_users in the beta version and enter the password tempestlinux (works for 64-bit systems only). 

And that’s not it yet! Right now we are working on the next patch for the game that addresses the following issues: 

 optimization the time for switching your location to the Jade Sea
 issues with walking around a galleon
 sails now appear properly on a junk boat
 wrong number of items aboard won't be shown if those items are also present in the warehouse
 ships sunk in certain missions now appear correctly
  you can now place two of the same item in slots to upgrade equipment
 you can't sell key items now
  item price in the shop is now shown with the discount
 typos in the tutorial text

Also while you are still here we are really happy to let you know that our friends have launched a Steam page for their new game:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/809140/Cliff_Empire/
Thank you for your attention, 
and until next time!

notes.title: It’s a high time to patch your vessels!
notes.notes:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11019625/daacf37d1f58135cd6232b7abb9b3b707bd12164.jpg
Pirates, we are happy to let you know that today Tempest got its new patch on Steam. Our crew is working hard to browse all the feedback you've been giving us to fix the most notorious bugs in the first place.

With this in mind the following issues have been fixed:

 Ships sailing continuously to the last chosen point after switching to map
 Emperor daughter does no gun damage during the land combat 
 While minimizing/switching to other apps/blocking the system music continues to play
 After system has been blocked the fog of war hides the whole map
 Waves graphical artefacts
 No ability to connect to a private multiplayer game by using its name
 Bugs while using gamepads
 Localisation bugs

We are very thankful for your support as together we will be able to make Tempest even better! 
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11019625/d6a6dfd4275d45519cc6f099fbbb48daa51024b0.png

notes.title: Tempest - Update #4 (Open World)
notes.notes:
Ahoy!

Have you ever wanted to free roam the high seas in the pirate world of Tempest? To stand by a ship's wheel? To build a team of three and plunder caravans and forts together in multiplayer?

True pirates such as you are always get what they want.

This is the largest update we ever made, it's based on a feedback from community which we've been gathering since day 1.

It includes open world, overhauled multiplayer, hundreds of fixes, balance tweaks and also new music!

New game is advised.

Full change log is coming later - it's that big that we didn't manage to make it in time.

Watch for more updates from us, this should be interesting!

Join us and good hunting!

Full change log is coming later - it's that big that we didn't manage to make it in time.

Watch for more updates from us, this should be interesting!

Join us and good hunting!

notes.title: Tempest - Update #3 (New Map, New Ships and New Quests)
notes.notes:
Ahoy! Third major update is here and it offers tons of fresh new content incl. a second map, more ships and quests. Definitely not the last update, we still got a long sail ahead!

New game is required!

http://imageshack.com/a/img922/1750/YDul8N.jpg
Tempest is two months old and look – we're growing!

What's new:

 Second map is available
 Ten quests for Pirates, two of them are available from the start, positive relations with the faction must be gained for other eight.
 Faction traits added for every settlement:
Pirates - 70% repair and 200 rust cannon balls free of charge
Seekers - energy refillment
Black Flame - crew training
Kingdom - banking services, deposits up to 15k coins
Dominion - 30 fire shells for free
Protectorate - free heal
Returners - damage your crew in exchange for 5% chance to gain an artifact
Order - a pay in gold for a chance to gain extra rating
Trade Coalition- better prices.

http://s12.postimg.org/4hyio978t/image.jpg
New world awaits...

 The Flying Dutchman is invincible again, she also has three Kraken artifacts to prevent player's escape.
 Speed has different impact on ship's maneuvering.
 Quest button is now active in Port Menu.
 Officer skill of looting is less profitable.
 Small ships now have less armor effect.
 Aiming buttons layout for battle interface is different.
 Energy regens only by 5 points in midnight.
 Forts now have longer reload time, they also don't shoot all at once.
 Boarding damage formula reworked - a boarding party with low HP will now do better.


http://s12.postimg.org/oa0onjist/image.jpg
So much to do...

 Positive rating bonus for battles is lesser now.
 Speed on the global map is reduced.
 Repairs are now 100% more costly.
 3 events for the allies of Pirate faction and 2 for their enemies.
 Death penalty is now 30% instead of 20% since there is a bank to stash gold now.
 Sea monsters now have better visuals.
 Some ports sell ship decorations.
 Forts don't attack a player anymore.
 Pricing on medicines is adjusted.
 Boarding: musket volley has a reload indicator.
 Battle Menu shows an approximate power of each side.
 Loot Button works differently - it takes 70% of loot from defeated enemies, hidden stashes must be found and collected manually.

http://s12.postimg.org/gg0325azx/image.jpg
Beauty - isn't she?

 List of goods is reworked.
 Base ship stats are lowered (aim, zone of fire).
 Initial rate of fire is lowered by one point.
 Ships cost more.
 Carronades are not as useful as used to be.
 High-aim mode gives a narrower zone of fire.
 A number of available quests is now shown above port icons on the global map.
 Escaping from a battle is forbidden for the first 30 seconds.
 Overall tweaking and bugfixes


Good hunting!

Tempest – Update #1 (Multiplayer) Is Live!
notes.notes:
First update of many has arrived, the second one is already in production. Most of changes, fixes and new features were implemented according to the feedback we received from our players. Thank you!

Changelog:
- MULTIPLAYER
- Manual shooting (press backspace to fire)
- Difficulty levels
- Trading system
- Now you can select cannonballs/artifacts using your keyboard during a battle
- Allies’ AI has been improved (yep, now there is less friendly-ramming)
- Repairs have become cheaper
- Penalty for losing a battle has been reduced
- Equipping items via a double click
- Better camera control using mouse	
- Now you can also repair your ships in villages (although not up to 100%)
- Entry points to a battle have been improved (further from enemies now)
- Game progress reset button has been added (available in setup menu)
- More screen resolutions support 
-Default language bug has been fixed
-Lots of minor tweaking and bug fixes

Multiplayer explained: from now on, in any battle, there`s a chance to play against or with other player. A real player would have a nickname right next to his ships marker.


Have fun and happy hunting!ːboardingː
